# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `xmake docs-config` from src/settings/BuiltinSchema.cpp. Do not edit by hand. -->

The configuration file is `~/.config/noctara/config.toml` (XDG_CONFIG_HOME is honoured). A documented template is written on first run, and edits are applied live.

Precedence, lowest first: built-in defaults, system config (`/etc/xdg/noctara/config.toml`), user config, `NOCTARA_*` environment variables, command-line flags (`--set key=value` or the listed aliases). Settings marked *restart* take effect on the next launch.

Secrets such as OAuth tokens and proxy credentials are never read from or written to this file; they live in the system secret store.

## General

### `[general]` Language

Interface language.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | enum | `"system"` | `system`, `en`, `ru` | **Language.** Applied immediately, without a restart. (env `NOCTARA_GENERAL_LANGUAGE`, CLI `--lang=`) |

### `[general.formatting]` Formatting

How times and numbers are displayed.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `time_format` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `12h`, `24h` | **Time format.** Clock style for dates and times. (env `NOCTARA_GENERAL_FORMATTING_TIME_FORMAT`) |
| `compact_numbers` | bool | `true` | — | **Compact numbers.** Show large counts as 1.2K instead of 1,234. (env `NOCTARA_GENERAL_FORMATTING_COMPACT_NUMBERS`) |

## Appearance

### `[appearance.theme]` Theme

Midnight (dark), Frost (light) or follow the system.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | enum | `"system"` | `system`, `dark`, `light` | **Theme.** System follows the desktop color scheme live. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_THEME_MODE`, CLI `--theme=`) |
| `enforce_contrast` | bool | `true` | — | **Enforce readable contrast.** Adjust colors that would fall below WCAG AA contrast against glass. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_THEME_ENFORCE_CONTRAST`) |

### `[appearance.accent]` Accent color

The whole palette is generated from a single accent color.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adaptive` | bool | `true` | — | **Adapt accent colors to cover art.** Derive the accent palette from the current track's artwork. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_ACCENT_ADAPTIVE`) |
| `color` | color | `"#6774f9"` | — | **Accent color.** Seed color for the whole palette when adaptive accents are off. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_ACCENT_COLOR`) |
| `extraction` | enum | `"vivid"` | `vivid`, `balanced`, `soft` | **Palette extraction.** How saturated the colours taken from the artwork are. Recomputed on every track. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_ACCENT_EXTRACTION`) |

### `[appearance.backdrop]` Backdrop

The light behind the interface.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | enum | `"aurora"` | `aurora`, `cover`, `dark` | **Backdrop style.** Aurora: soft light in the palette colours. Cover art: the blurred artwork. Dark: nearly plain. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_BACKDROP_STYLE`) |
| `animate` | bool | `true` | — | **Animate backdrop.** Slow drifting motion. Paused automatically when the window is hidden. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_BACKDROP_ANIMATE`) |

### `[appearance.glow]` Glow

Soft accent-coloured light around artwork, controls and progress.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | number | `0.3` | 0 … 1 | **Glow intensity.** Strength of the glow and of the backdrop light. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLOW_INTENSITY`) |
| `cover` | bool | `true` | — | **Artwork glow.** A shadow in the artwork's colour under covers. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLOW_COVER`) |
| `controls` | bool | `true` | — | **Button and selection glow.** A soft halo around accented buttons and active items. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLOW_CONTROLS`) |
| `progress` | bool | `true` | — | **Progress glow.** Lights up the played part of the progress bar and waveform. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLOW_PROGRESS`) |

### `[appearance.glass]` Glass

How translucent surfaces are rendered.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | enum | `"kawase"` | `kawase`, `gaussian`, `liquid`, `solid` | **Glass style.** Blur styles need hardware acceleration; Solid is the cheapest. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_STYLE`) |
| `blur_strength` | number | `0.6` | 0 … 1 | **Blur strength.** How strongly the backdrop is blurred. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_BLUR_STRENGTH`) |
| `opacity` | number | `0.0` | 0 … 1 | **Glass tint.** Opacity of the tint applied to glass surfaces. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_OPACITY`) |
| `grain` | number | `0.0` | 0 … 1 | **Grain.** Fine noise that prevents banding in gradients. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_GRAIN`) |
| `quality` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `low`, `medium`, `high` | **Effects quality.** Auto lowers quality when frames take too long and raises it again later. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_QUALITY`) |
| `buttons` | enum | `"frosted"` | `frosted`, `liquid`, `tinted`, `clear`, `solid` | **Button material.** Frosted: milky blurred glass. Liquid: glossy glass with a bright rim. Tinted: glass coloured by the accent. Clear: outline only. Solid: opaque. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_BUTTONS`) |
| `reduce_transparency` | bool | `false` | — | **Reduce transparency.** Use opaque surfaces everywhere. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_REDUCE_TRANSPARENCY`) |

### `[appearance.motion]` Motion

Animations and transitions.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reduce` | bool | `false` | — | **Reduce motion.** Replace movement with simple fades and stop the drifting backdrop. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_MOTION_REDUCE`) |
| `speed` | number | `1.0` | 0 … 3 | **Animation speed.** Duration multiplier. 0 turns animations off. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_MOTION_SPEED`) |
| `color_transition` | enum | `"smooth"` | `fast`, `smooth`, `slow` | **Colour transitions.** How quickly colours blend into the new palette when the track or theme changes. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_MOTION_COLOR_TRANSITION`) |

### `[appearance.shape]` Shape

Corner rounding of surfaces and artwork.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `corner_radius` | enum | `"default"` | `sharp`, `default`, `round`, `custom` | **Corner radius.** Rounding of panels, cards and buttons. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_SHAPE_CORNER_RADIUS`) |
| `corner_radius_multiplier` | number | `1.0` | 0 … 2 | **Corner radius multiplier.** Scales every corner radius. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_SHAPE_CORNER_RADIUS_MULTIPLIER`) |
| `buttons` | enum | `"pill"` | `pill`, `soft`, `sharp` | **Button shape.** Corner style of buttons and segmented controls. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_SHAPE_BUTTONS`) |
| `cover_art` | enum | `"rounded"` | `rounded`, `square`, `circle` | **Cover art shape.** Shape of artwork in lists and the player. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_SHAPE_COVER_ART`) |

### `[appearance.text]` Text and scale

Interface zoom and fonts. Missing fonts fall back to the bundled ones.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ui_scale` | integer | `100` | 75 … 200 | **Interface zoom.** Scales the whole interface. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_UI_SCALE`) |
| `font_scale` | integer | `100` | 80 … 150 | **Text size.** Scales text relative to the interface zoom. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_FONT_SCALE`) |
| `heading_font` | string | `""` | — | **Heading font.** Font family for titles. Empty uses Manrope. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_HEADING_FONT`) |
| `body_font` | string | `""` | — | **Body font.** Font family for interface text. Empty uses Inter. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_BODY_FONT`) |
| `mono_font` | string | `""` | — | **Monospace font.** Font family for timings and technical details. Empty uses JetBrains Mono. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_MONO_FONT`) |

### `[appearance.icons]` Icons

Icon appearance.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `weight` | enum | `"regular"` | `light`, `regular`, `bold` | **Icon weight.** Stroke thickness of icons. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_ICONS_WEIGHT`) |

## Layout

### `[layout.content]` Content

How densely pages are laid out.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `density` | enum | `"cozy"` | `compact`, `cozy`, `airy` | **Density.** Spacing between sections, cards and rows. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_CONTENT_DENSITY`) |

## Performance

### `[performance.gpu]` Graphics

GPU acceleration. Changes take effect after a restart.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `acceleration` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `on`, `off` | **Hardware acceleration.** Auto uses the GPU unless it is missing, a software rasterizer or known to be unreliable. Off renders on the CPU and disables blur effects. (*restart*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_GPU_ACCELERATION`, CLI `--gpu=`) |
| `api` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `vulkan`, `opengl` | **Graphics API.** Rendering backend used for hardware acceleration. (*restart*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_GPU_API`, CLI `--graphics-api=`) |
| `preference` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `integrated`, `discrete` | **GPU preference.** Which GPU to use on systems with more than one. (*restart*, *advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_GPU_PREFERENCE`) |

### `[performance.rendering]` Rendering

Frame pacing.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vsync` | bool | `true` | — | **Vertical sync.** Synchronise frames with the display to avoid tearing. (*restart*, *advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_RENDERING_VSYNC`) |
| `frame_rate_cap` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `30`, `60`, `120`, `144`, `unlimited` | **Frame rate limit.** Upper bound for animation frame rate. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_RENDERING_FRAME_RATE_CAP`) |

### `[performance.power]` Power

How Noctara reduces its own energy use. Your system power profile is not changed.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `energy_saving` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `always`, `off` | **Energy saving.** While active, Noctara pauses the animated backdrop, uses the lighter Dual Kawase blur instead of Liquid Glass or Gaussian, and limits animations to 30 frames per second. Automatic turns it on only while the computer runs on battery. (env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_POWER_ENERGY_SAVING`) |

## Network

### `[network.usage]` Data usage

When and how much Noctara downloads.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `offline` | bool | `false` | — | **Offline mode.** Make no network connections at all. Only content that is already cached is available. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_USAGE_OFFLINE`, CLI `--offline=`) |
| `metered` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `on`, `off` | **Metered connection.** On a metered connection Noctara skips prefetching and other background downloads. Auto follows the system's setting for the current network. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_USAGE_METERED`) |
| `bandwidth_limit` | integer | `0` | 0 … 1000 | **Download speed limit.** Upper bound for all downloads together. 0 means no limit. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_USAGE_BANDWIDTH_LIMIT`) |

### `[network.dns]` DNS

How server names are turned into addresses. Applies to all of Noctara's connections without a restart.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | enum | `"system"` | `system`, `custom`, `doh` | **DNS mode.** System uses your computer's settings. DNS over HTTPS encrypts lookups so the network cannot see or change them. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_MODE`, CLI `--dns=`) |
| `server_preset` | enum | `"cloudflare"` | `cloudflare`, `google`, `quad9`, `adguard`, `custom` | **DNS servers.** Asked in order; the next one is tried when a server does not answer. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_SERVER_PRESET`) |
| `servers` | string list | `[]` | — | **Server addresses.** IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, optionally with a port: 192.0.2.1, [2001:db8::1]:5353. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_SERVERS`) |
| `doh_provider` | enum | `"cloudflare"` | `cloudflare`, `google`, `quad9`, `adguard`, `mullvad`, `custom` | **DNS-over-HTTPS provider.** Custom accepts any RFC 8484 server, for example a personal NextDNS address. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_DOH_PROVIDER`) |
| `doh_url` | url | `""` | — | **DoH address.** For example https://dns.example/dns-query. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_DOH_URL`) |
| `doh_bootstrap` | string list | `[]` | — | **Bootstrap addresses.** IP addresses of the DoH server, so its own name never has to be looked up elsewhere. Required when fallback to the system resolver is off. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_DOH_BOOTSTRAP`) |
| `doh_allow_insecure` | bool | `false` | — | **Allow insecure DoH.** Accept a plain http:// address, but only for a server on this computer or the local network. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_DOH_ALLOW_INSECURE`) |
| `fallback_to_system` | bool | `true` | — | **Fall back to the system resolver.** Keeps Noctara working when the chosen servers are unreachable, but those lookups are then visible to your network. Off is strict mode: lookups fail instead. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_FALLBACK_TO_SYSTEM`) |
| `ip_family` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `prefer_ipv4`, `prefer_ipv6`, `ipv4`, `ipv6` | **IP version.** Auto tries IPv6 and IPv4 in parallel and keeps whichever connects first. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_IP_FAMILY`) |
| `host_overrides` | string list | `[]` | — | **Host overrides.** Fixed addresses that skip DNS, as host=address. Repeat a host to give it several addresses. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_HOST_OVERRIDES`) |

### `[network.dns.cache]` DNS cache

How long answers are remembered. Lifetimes from the DNS server are kept within these bounds.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min_ttl` | integer | `60` | 0 … 3600 | **Minimum lifetime.** Answers are kept at least this long. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_CACHE_MIN_TTL`) |
| `max_ttl` | integer | `3600` | 60 … 86400 | **Maximum lifetime.** Answers are looked up again after this long. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_CACHE_MAX_TTL`) |
| `negative_ttl` | integer | `30` | 0 … 3600 | **Failed lookups.** How long a name that does not exist is remembered as missing. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_CACHE_NEGATIVE_TTL`) |

### `[network.proxy]` Proxy

Route Noctara's traffic through a proxy server.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | enum | `"system"` | `none`, `system`, `manual` | **Proxy mode.** System uses the proxy variables of the environment (http_proxy, no_proxy …) or, if none are set, your desktop's proxy settings. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_MODE`, CLI `--proxy-mode=`) |
| `type` | enum | `"http"` | `http`, `https`, `socks4`, `socks5`, `socks5h` | **Proxy type.** HTTPS encrypts the connection to the proxy itself. With SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 Noctara looks up server names itself; the others let the proxy do it. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_TYPE`) |
| `host` | string | `""` | — | **Proxy host.** Host name or IP address of the proxy server. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_HOST`) |
| `port` | integer | `8080` | 1 … 65535 | **Proxy port.** Username and password, if the proxy needs them, are kept in the system keyring, never in the configuration file. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_PORT`) |
| `bypass` | string list | `[]` | — | **Connect directly to.** Hosts that bypass the proxy: example.com (with its subdomains), *.example.com, IP addresses or ranges such as 10.0.0.0/8. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_BYPASS`) |
| `bypass_local` | bool | `true` | — | **Bypass for local addresses.** Connect directly to localhost, private networks and names without a dot. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_BYPASS_LOCAL`) |

### `[network.connection]` Connections

Protocol, time limits and retries.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `http_version` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `1.1`, `2`, `3` | **HTTP version.** Auto uses HTTP/2 where the server supports it. HTTP/3 falls back to older versions when it is blocked. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_HTTP_VERSION`) |
| `connect_timeout` | integer | `15` | 1 … 120 | **Connection timeout.** How long to wait for a server, including the proxy and the encrypted handshake. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`) |
| `read_timeout` | integer | `30` | 5 … 300 | **Stall timeout.** A download is aborted (and retried) when no data arrives for this long. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_READ_TIMEOUT`) |
| `retries` | integer | `2` | 0 … 10 | **Retries.** How often a failed request is repeated. Only requests that are safe to repeat are retried. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_RETRIES`) |
| `retry_backoff` | integer | `500` | 100 … 10000 | **Retry delay.** Wait before the first retry; it doubles with every further attempt. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_RETRY_BACKOFF`) |
| `max_connections` | integer | `16` | 1 … 64 | **Maximum connections.** Open connections in total. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_MAX_CONNECTIONS`) |
| `max_per_host` | integer | `6` | 1 … 32 | **Connections per server.** Open connections to one server. HTTP/2 carries many requests over one. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_MAX_PER_HOST`) |

### `[network.tls]` Security

Encrypted connections. Certificates are always verified.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min_version` | enum | `"1.2"` | `1.2`, `1.3` | **Minimum TLS version.** Older protocol versions are never used. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_TLS_MIN_VERSION`) |
| `ca_bundle` | path | `""` | — | **CA bundle.** PEM file with the certificate authorities to trust instead of the system's, for networks that inspect encrypted traffic. Empty uses the system store. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_TLS_CA_BUNDLE`) |
